title: Birthday record with Fats Waller, about 1937
summary: Rose recalls a casual recording made at the station in about 1937 on which Fats Waller wished him happy birthday, ten years before Journeys Into Jazz.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: commercial session. I mean, we just happened to be up in the station. And we, as a matter of fact, it was on my birthday then, too. And the record opens with the Fats saying, this is for my boy Al, you know, happy birthday, and so on. What year would that be? Oh, this was about 1937. And was this before Journeys into Jazz started? Oh yes, that was substantially before Journeys into Jazz. That was ten years before Journeys into Jazz.
I'm beginning to get the picture on you. So you, your activities date back before being in the jazz business, date back before Journeys into Jazz? Oh yes.
